snippet.title: Whirlight - No Time To Trip - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
